'''Gemjool''' was a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Kor Gorensla]], a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] located in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].

==Description==
Gemjool was one of the six [[Moon/Legends|moons]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] [[Kor Gorensla]], a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] located in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] that served as the [[Throneworld/Legends|throneworld]] of the [[Gorensla/Legends|Gorensla]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]].<ref name="LoNH" />

Gemjool was heavily [[Terraforming/Legends|terraformed]] and housed several important Gorensla estates. These estates were filled with ancient, exotic wares from across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. These valuable items represented great investments for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] of Gorensla, as they often stored them in the hopes of revealing them [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] or [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] later to make a tidy profit.<ref name="LoNH" />
